name: Futakuchi-onna
description: Futakuchi-onna is a Japanese yokai — a two-mouthed woman — whose hair moves like serpents to feed a second, fully functional mouth on the back of her head that screams demands for food and causes excruciating pain if unfed.
origin: A creature of Japanese folklore; associated with rural Japan in the Edo period and earlier. No specific geographic region within Japan is particularly associated with the futakuchi-onna.
